responsibility: Provides Rust-specific wrappers and borrowed C++-frontend tree utilities for operating on GCC tree expressions and types during lowering and constant checking. It defines global tree state expected by the frontend, helpers for marking reads and lvalue/rvalue use, converting references, discarding or void-converting expressions, folding rvalues, diagnosing non-literal classes and incomplete types, and several type-relationship utilities that support Rust’s use of GCC middle-end tree semantics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the Rust tree helper routines and defines frontend tree globals declared for this backend, including expression-use marking, reference conversion, constant-folding helpers, and diagnostic/type-relationship functions; unlike rust-tree.h, it supplies the operational code behind those tree utilities instead of the macros, inline predicates, and declarations.
